A few questions

Does Ricky work in my area?

Call him with your address and he'll tell you if your street is one he covers.

How soon can he come out?

That depends on the week. Ask when you call and you'll get a straight answer.

Can I ask about a small job?

Yes. Describe it on the phone or in the form, and Ricky will tell you whether it's one he can take on.

Do I have to call?

No. You can use the form on this page instead.
